integrity_statement: Mathematical claims and comparisons concern only the stated stochastic process. Standalone exact-rational verification supplements a complete recursive and analytic proof. No external independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Equal species proposal rates; repeated independent Poisson attempts; simple finite cycles with at least three vertices. No biased-rate or distributional terminal-count theorem. The finite-ring formula was numerically conjectured in the 2022 source; this result supplies a proof, boundary generating functions and finite-size monotonicity.
title: An exact finite-ring law for antagonistic two-species adsorption
